css: :root{--sm-bg:#09050D;--sm-ink:#FEFCFF;--sm-lilac:#D3C3E8;--sm-purple:#805D9D;--sm-signal:#F2FFDC;--sm-line:rgba(211,195,232,.2);--sm-font-body:"Alibaba PuHuiTi 3.0","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;--sm-font-display:Outfit,"SF Pro Display",sans-serif}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--sm-bg);color:var(--sm-ink);font:16px/1.5 var(--sm-font-body)}button{min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--sm-line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px;background:transparent;color:var(--sm-ink);font:inherit;cursor:pointer}button:hover,button[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--sm-signal);color:var(--sm-signal)}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--sm-signal);outline-offset:3px}.revenue-review{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(24px,5vw,72px);background:var(--sm-bg)}.hero{border-bottom:1px solid var(--sm-line);padding-bottom:32px}.eyebrow{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--sm-lilac);font:600 13px/1.2 var(--sm-font-display);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}.hero h1{margin:0;font:600 clamp(32px,6vw,64px)/1.08 var(--sm-font-display);letter-spacing:-.03em}.notice{display:inline-block;margin:20px 0 0;padding:8px 12px;border-left:3px solid var(--sm-signal);color:var(--sm-signal);background:rgba(242,255,220,.06)}.scope-switcher{display:flex;gap:12px;margin:28px 0}.kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}.kpi-card,.chart-panel{border:1px solid var(--sm-line);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}.kpi-card{padding:20px}.kpi-label{margin:0;color:var(--sm-lilac);font-size:14px}.kpi-value{margin:12px 0 0;font:600 clamp(28px,5vw,48px)/1 var(--sm-font-display);color:var(--sm-ink)}.kpi-meta{margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--sm-lilac);font-size:13px}.chart-panel{margin-top:16px;padding:20px}.section-heading{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.section-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:18px}.section-heading span{color:var(--sm-lilac);font-size:14px}.chart-bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;min-height:180px;padding:24px 8px 8px}.chart-bar{flex:1;min-width:20px;height:var(--bar-height);border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;background:var(--sm-purple);position:relative}.chart-bar span{position:absolute;bottom:-28px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);color:var(--sm-lilac);font-size:12px}.boundary{margin:28px 0 0;color:var(--sm-lilac);font-size:13px}.kpi-grid:empty:after{content:"正在加载示例指标";color:var(--sm-lilac)}@media (max-width:720px){.revenue-review{padding:24px 16px}.kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.chart-bars{gap:6px}.hero h1{font-size:40px}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important}}@media (forced-colors:active){button,.kpi-card,.chart-panel{border:1px solid CanvasText;background:Canvas;color:CanvasText}.notice{border-color:Highlight;color:Highlight}.chart-bar{background:Highlight}}
js: (function(){const root=document.querySelector('[data-shine-node="revenue-review"]');const grid=document.getElementById('kpiGrid');const bars=document.getElementById('chartBars');const label=document.getElementById('scopeLabel');const datasets={all:{scopeLabel:'全部',cards:[['kpi-card-peak','峰值日','周三','示例观察'],['kpi-card-total','示例金额','¥128,400','未绑定数据'],['kpi-card-rate','变化率','+12.4%','演示趋势']],bars:[42,58,76,54,88,64,72]},weekend:{scopeLabel:'周末',cards:[['kpi-card-peak','峰值日','周六','示例观察'],['kpi-card-total','示例金额','¥46,200','未绑定数据'],['kpi-card-rate','变化率','+6.8%','演示趋势']],bars:[28,44,36,68,52,82,60]}};const state={scope:'all'};function render(){const data=datasets[state.scope];root.dataset.scope=state.scope;label.textContent=data.scopeLabel;data.cards.forEach(([id,title,value,meta])=>{const card=grid.querySelector('[data-shine-node="'+id+'"]');card.querySelector('.kpi-label').textContent=title;card.querySelector('.kpi-value').textContent=value;card.querySelector('.kpi-meta').textContent=meta;});bars.replaceChildren(...data.bars.map((value,index)=>{const bar=document.createElement('div');bar.className='chart-bar';bar.style.setProperty('--bar-height',(value+12)+'%');bar.setAttribute('aria-label','示例第 '+(index+1)+' 天');const day=document.createElement('span');day.textContent='D'+(index+1);bar.append(day);return bar;}));document.querySelectorAll('[data-scope]').forEach(button=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(button.dataset.scope===state.scope)));}document.querySelectorAll('[data-scope]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>api.setScope(button.dataset.scope)));const api={state,setScope(scope){if(!datasets[scope])return;state.scope=scope;render();},render};window.RevenueReview=api;render();})();
